rules.rule: Enumeration entries are base-typed values, not lexical strings
Equal signed/zero-padded representations denote same integer; duplicate source entries still consume capacity
rules.profileLimit: 16source entries,256UTF16lexical characters and explicit native digits before normalization

rules.rule: Entry declaration must satisfy base bounds/facets, not new sibling facets
All value-based facets constrain instances jointly; sibling enumeration and max/totalDigits may have empty intersection without an extra schema-invalid rule
Inherited enumeration retained unless supplied replacement; replacement entries must belong to base value space
Do not extend existing user simple chains or complex restriction depth
